# Demo Assets

<!-- Generated by Claude Sonnet 4.5 -->

This directory contains sample audio files for the wavesurfer widget demo.

## sample.mp3

- **Source**: https://download.samplelib.com/mp3/sample-3s.mp3
- **License**: Free to use for testing purposes
- **Duration**: ~3 seconds
- **Format**: MP3, 64 kbps, 44.1 kHz, Stereo
- **Size**: ~51 KB
- **Purpose**: Default sample audio for `wavesurfer_demo.py`

This is a short audio clip used to demonstrate the wavesurfer widget without requiring users to upload their own audio files.

## Usage

The demo notebook automatically loads this file if no audio is uploaded. To use your own audio:

1. Run the demo: `marimo run demos/wavesurfer_demo.py`
2. Use the file picker in the notebook to upload your own MP3/WAV file
3. Or replace `sample.mp3` with your own audio file

## License

The sample audio file is provided for testing and demonstration purposes. For production use, please provide your own appropriately licensed audio files.
